tool_input.command:
git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
docs: amend seed-content-upgrade design for the additive-repair exception

The design's decision matrix and its recorded operator ruling ("no
pre-feature migration" / "the software keeps today's no-clobber skip for
untracked files") were contradicted by the additive-repair fix without any
note explaining why. Amends docs/seed-content-upgrade.md:

- Decision matrix and "Spelled out" list gain the new untracked +
  purely-additive-diff branch (repair, not recorded), distinct from every
  other untracked diff (still the original no-clobber skip).
- New "2026-09-19 ruling" section states the dated operator ruling
  verbatim, explains why this exception is narrower and provably safer
  than the general bootstrap-upgrade branch the original design rejected
  (it only ever adds keys proven absent, verified before and after the
  write), and why the repair is deliberately not recorded in the manifest.
- The ADR-proposal block's "Decision" and "Rulings" bullets, and the main
  body's "Rejected alternatives" bootstrap-upgrade bullet, each gain a
  short amendment note pointing at the ruling rather than silently
  standing contradicted.
- Result struct snippet and command-output example updated for the real
  RepairedFields/SkipReasons fields and print format; the remedy-line
  condition (len(Edited) > 0, not Skipped+Edited) corrected to match the
  actual code.
- Tests section gains the five new additive-repair test cases.

Also, two wording-truthfulness fixes surfaced by review:

- CHANGELOG: "only a pure schema gap self-heals" softened to the precise
  condition — no conflicting value and no user-added key — since "schema
  gap" alone doesn't name what's actually required.
- archetype_check.go's doctor remedy claimed "ethos seed only writes the
  global layer", which is false in general (it also writes repo-local
  review-checklist agents to .claude/agents/) — scoped to what's actually
  true: seed never writes a repo-local ARCHETYPE, only the global one.
EOF
)"
